name: Phaea Blue Palace
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary offers front-row seats to some of the most dramatic sunsets in the Mediterranean, with private pools that seem to spill directly into the Aegean Sea.
whats_special: Built into the rugged coastline of Elounda, Phaea Blue Palace features bungalows and villas cascaded down hillside terraces, each with infinity pools overlooking Spinalonga Island - a former Venetian fortress and leper colony turned UNESCO World Heritage candidate. The resort's unique architecture mimics a traditional Cretan village while offering ultra-luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's cliffside restaurant during a full moon - you'll witness the rare phenomenon of moonlight creating a silver pathway across the water to the mysterious Spinalonga Island.
dont_miss: Take the resort's private boat to explore Spinalonga Island's haunting ruins and learn about its fascinating history as Europe's last active leper colony until 1957. The 20-minute journey offers incredible photo opportunities of the resort's dramatic clifftop silhouette from the water.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location in Elounda with panoramic sea views
Multiple dining options featuring Mediterranean cuisine
Private beach access and infinity pools
cons: Remote location requires transportation to explore nearby areas
Premium pricing for luxury amenities and services
